display.name: Datadog
display.blurb: Query logs and metrics during a run. The API key is brokered — substituted at the egress proxy, never seen by the agent.

cli.doc: Use `datadog-ci` to interact with Datadog from this session. Authentication is automatic — `DD_API_KEY` is a managed placeholder the egress proxy replaces with the real API key on requests to api.datadoghq.com. Do NOT set a real key. Only the operations your profile enabled (e.g. `logs:read`) are brokered; commands that need a Datadog *application* key are not wired in this version.
